The company's Visumo platform collects posted photos from Instagram and other social media sites with hashtags and can be used for own website content. It serves clients in apparel, beauty and cosmetics, interior, food, tourism, local governments, and other sectors. The company was incorporated in 2019 and is based in Shibuya, Japan. visumo Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Softcreate Holdings Corp.

ipos.name: ＧＶＡ ＴＥＣＨ（株）
ipos.summary_en: GVA TECH,Inc. engages in the development and provision of legal tech platforms. It offers OLGA, a legal operating system that offers services for companies with legal departments; online service that supports the preparation of documents for commercial and company change registrations; corporate registration certificate acquisition service, including GVA Corporate Registration, GVA Register Acquisition, and GVA Trademark Registration; and AI-powered confidentiality agreement checking service. GVA TECH,Inc. was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

ipos.name: MIC（株）
ipos.summary_en: MIC Co., Ltd. provides retail sales promotion support services in Japan. It offers support services from manufacturing to delivery, and display of promotional tools; PromOS, a cloud-based platform that manages systems and information related to sales promotion; Co.HUB, a joint delivery service that consolidates promotional tools from each manufacturer at a promotion management center and delivers them to stores; and designer on-site support services. The company also provides business improvement consulting, system development, BPO, creative designing, printing, fulfillment, and field supporting services. MIC Co., Ltd. was founded in 1946 and is based in Tokyo, Japan. MIC Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of M2 Corporation.

ipos.name: アルピコホールディングス（株）
ipos.summary_en: Alpico Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the distribution business in Japan. It operates through Distribution Business, Transportation Business, Tourism Business, Real Estate Business, and Other Service Business segments. The company operates food supermarkets under the Delicia brand name; commercial product stores under the Gyomu Super and U-Palette brand; mobile sales vehicles under the Tokushimaru name; a self-service unmanned payment store; online supermarkets; pharmaceutical stores; and burger and coffee shops. It is also involved in the bus, taxi, and railway transportation; automobile maintenance, such as vehicle inspection, maintenance, bodywork painting, and vehicle sales; operation of city and business hotels, hot spring resort hotels, inns, and service areas, as well as leisure facilities, including golf courses and campgrounds; travel agency; real estate rental and villa subdivision management business; and insurance activities. Alpico Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Matsumoto, Japan.

ipos.name: 令和アカウンティング・ホールディングス（株）
ipos.summary_en: Reiwa Accounting Holdings Co., Ltd. provides consulting services focused on accounting operations and business management in Japan. It provides payroll calculation, temporary staffing, recruitment, accounting, bookkeeping certification, labor management, labor consulting, and other business process outsourcing services, as well as planning and running training and seminars on accounting practices. The company also engages in the planning, design, production, development, and sales of systems related to accounting operations; the operation, maintenance, management, and updating of IT systems; and the planning, investigation, research, development, technical support, training, and consulting related to systems for management, business, information processing, and information communication. In addition, It provides consulting services related to management and finance, along with related services. The company serves various clients, including companies, students, accounting staff, and other related parties. Reiwa Accounting Holdings Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

ipos.name: dely（株）
ipos.summary_en: Kurashiru, Inc. engages in the platform business in Japan, Singapore, and internationally. It offers advertising services, including Kurashiru, a recipe video platform; Receipt Challenge by Kurashiru, a smart savings app; Kurashiru AI OS, an AI agent platform for CPG brands, wholesalers, and retailers; TRILL, a lifestyle information media; and LIVEwith, a creator management agency. The company was formerly known as dely Inc. and changed its name to Kurashiru, Inc. in October 2025. Kurashiru, Inc. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

ipos.name: （株）Synspective
ipos.summary_en: Synspective Inc. designs, builds, and operates a fleet of synthetic aperture radar satellites (SAR) to detect and understand changes. It offers land displacement monitoring, flood damage assessment, disaster damage assessment, offshore wind and wave, and forest inventory management solutions. The company's product includes StriX satellite to observe and analyze the Earth's surface down to sub-meter resolutions. It also provides Synspective Data Platform that offers access to SAR data for searching, ordering, and downloading data to find solutions in social infrastructure management, disaster response, environmental monitoring, security, and intelligence fields. Synspective Inc. was founded in 2018 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

ipos.name: キオクシアホールディングス（株）
ipos.summary_en: Kioxia Holdings Corporation engages in research, development, manufacturing, sales, and other services of memory and related products for solid state drives (SSDs) and storage and smart devices in Japan, North America, Europe, and Asia. The company offers flash memory, SSDs, SD memory cards, and other retail products. It is also involved in the product and software development of SSD products; marketing of memory and SSD products; production management of subcontracted production in the post-process of memory; production and distribution of memory and photomask for semiconductor products; energy management business; and entrusted engineering work of CIM developments, as well as provides cleaning and health keeping for development center, and customer support services. The company was formerly known as Toshiba Memory Holdings Corporation and changed its name to Kioxia Holdings Corporation in October 2019. Kioxia Holdings Corporation was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

ipos.name: （株）リスキル
ipos.summary_en: Reskill Corp. engages in the corporate employee training business in Japan. It provides level-specific training services, including new employee, young employee, mid-career employee, and management training services; and training services, such as compliance and harassment, customer service, leadership, communication, presentation, motivation, mental health, risk management, subordinate development and junior guidance, diversity, writing, communication, thinking, planning, business improvement, computer and office automation skills, accounting, finance and legal, self-reliance, personnel evaluation, and career training services. The company also offers job-specific training services comprising sales, marketing, personnel, and call center training services; and industry-specific training services, including IT and communications, service, corporate services, distribution, and construction and real estate industries, as well as training for the manufacturing, logistics and transportation, organization and non-profit corporation, advertising, and publishing industries. In addition, it provides IT training services, such as digital transformation, IT certification, web design, programming, system design, infrastructure, security, database, AI, advanced technology, development tool, project management, design, and quality control training services. The company was founded in 1986 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

ipos.name: 黒田グループ（株）
ipos.summary_en:
Kuroda Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells goods and materials for data storage, automotive, and electronics industries in Japan and internationally. It offers printing plates for alignment film printing for liquid crystal panels; automated assembly and inspection equipment; ultrasonic soldering devices; aluminum die-casting products; 
and assembly equipment for disk drives. The company is also involved in contract development and manufacturing services, including product development for development engineers, manufacturing and development of embedded and evaluation board, and electronic circuit board design; automation equipment; manufacture and sell resin molded products and plastic molding dies for automotive; seals, labels, and filters for hard disk drive; surface treatment processing; and laser processing business of electronic components for automobiles and mobile devices. In addition, it trades in electronic parts and materials. The company was formerly known as KM Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Kuroda Group Co., Ltd. in April 2020. The company was founded in 1945 and is based in Shinagawa, Japan.

ipos.name: ラクサス・テクノロジーズ（株）
ipos.summary_en: Laxus Technologies Inc. provides sharing brand bags services through subscription-type membership in Japan. The company was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan.

ipos.name: （株）ユカリア
ipos.summary_en: EUCALIA Inc. offers hospital management support services in Japan. The company offers consulting on organizational restructuring and business succession for medical institutions; plans, designs, and constructs building and structures; and manages, consults and introduces elderly care facilities. It also manufactures and sells contact lens and designs, develops, sells, and maintains package systems. EUCALIA Inc. was formerly known as Capital Medica Co., Ltd and changed its name to EUCALIA Inc. in May 2022. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

ipos.name: （株）ＱＬＳホールディングス
ipos.summary_en: QLS Holdings Co., Ltd, through its subsidiaries, engages in the childcare businesses in Japan. The company operates through Childcare, Nursing care, and Staffing Segment. It also offers nursing care services, such as home visit care, in-home nursing care support, after-school care, and home support services, as well as disability welfare and temporary staffing services. In addition, the company manages nurseries, daycare centers, kindergartens, and after-school clubs; and mobile phones and other telecommunications equipment. QLS Holdings Co., Ltd was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan. QLS Holdings Co., Ltd operates as a subsidiary of Grit Co. Ltd.

ipos.name: インフォメティス（株）
ipos.summary_en: Informetis Co., Ltd. engages in the energy informatics business in Japan. It offers ienowa and enenova for reducing the use of electricity by home appliances, generating electricity from solar power, and store electricity; and hitonowa, an energy management service for electric power companies. Informetis Co., Ltd. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

ipos.name: （株）ＴＭＨ
ipos.summary_en: TMH Inc. engages in the purchase, repair, and sale of semiconductor manufacturing equipment parts in Japan, Asia, the United States, and internationally. It also operates LAYLA, an online marketplace for the semiconductor industry. In addition, the company offers heater, bratron, ceramic heater, chamber parts, chiller, dome, equipment parts, esc, generator, jacket heater, LFM, magnet, mass flow controller, motor driver, sensor, spindle, touch panel, valve, VODM, cryopump, turbo pump, and robot products. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is headquartered in Oita, Japan.

ipos.name: Terra Drone（株）
ipos.summary_en: Terra Drone Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of industrial drone solutions in Japan, Belgium, the Netherlands, the Republic of Indonesia, and internationally. The company is involved in the development of unmanned aircraft system traffic management systems for enhancing the safety of drones and urban air mobility flights. The company also provides aerial solutions for spraying pesticides, fertilizers, and pest control products for agricultural plantations, as well as land survey and plant monitoring, mapping and analysis of soil conditions, and monitoring weather conditions and rainfall. In addition, it offers Terra UT drones and Terra 3D Inspect, a cloud-based platform for inspection of tanks, boilers, and various infrastructure facilities in the petrochemical and electric power industries. Further, the company provides Terra Lidar drones for construction and engineering, mining exploration, and GIS solutions. It serves land surveying, forest survey, mine surveying, infrastructure inspection, and oil and gas inspection sectors. The company has a strategic alliance with Quest UAV Ltd. Terra Drone Corporation was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

ipos.name: グロービング（株）
ipos.summary_en: Globe-ing Inc. provides DX and strategic consulting, and digital analytics/data services in Japan. The company offers cloud products, including Sales Suite, a solution to improve sales productivity; and Spend Intelligence Suite, a solution to optimize a company's external spending. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

ipos.name: ククレブ・アドバイザーズ（株）
ipos.summary_en: CCReB Advisors Inc. provides corporate real estate (CRE) solution in Japan. It develops real estate tech systems to support businesses, such as real estate investment, real estate buying and selling, rental brokerage, consulting, and project management. The company also offers CCReB GATEWAY, a B2B portal site that provides the latest management trends and essential information for corporate management; CCReB AI, a CRE sales support system; CCReB CREMa, a commercial real estate matching system; CCReB PROP, a fixed asset data extraction tool; CCReB Clip, an information support tool that creates target lists based on computer disclosure documents, including prospect lists, market statistics, and other analytical datasets; CCReB BI, a real estate research tool; and CCChat, a chat system utilizing generative AI. CCReB Advisors Inc. was incorporated in 2019 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

ipos.name: （株）ガーデン
ipos.summary_en: Garden Co., Ltd. operates restaurants in Japan and Southeast Asia. The company provides ramen, steak, and sushi products. It also operates franchise stores. In addition, the company is involved in the real estate business. The company operates through Ikkaku family, Yamashita Honki Udon, Manbaken, Takadaya, Shin Nikuzushiman, Passionate Sutameshi Dondon, Iron Plate Kingdom, The Veranda RRainbow, Teraccho, Daruma no Me, Abura Soba Sohonten, Ikkakudo, Shinagawa Seimenjo, MARZAC MARZAC7, SUSHI PREMIUM Kaiou, and Ichiryu brands. Garden Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

ipos.name: （株）Sapeet
ipos.summary_en: Sapeet Inc. provides artificial intelligence (AI) solutions and products in Japan. The company's services include sales AI agent construction service, generative AI consulting/development support, planning and support for store DX and OMO measures, DX support for customer service standardization, AI posture and motion analysis, and new business support in the healthcare and wellness fields. It also offers Culticloud, a cloud service that streamlines communication between business owners and their customers. The company was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

ipos.name: Ｈｍｃｏｍｍ（株）
ipos.summary_en: Hmcomm Inc. develops products using voice recognition processing, abnormal sound detection, and natural language analysis processing. The company provides AI utilization consulting solutions. It also promotes cybernics business related to sound, such as information technology, artificial intelligence, and robotics. The company was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

ipos.name: リガク・ホールディングス（株）
ipos.summary_en: Rigaku Holdings Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of scientific equipment in Japan, the United States, Europe, and Asia. The company offers multipurpose analytical instruments, such as X-ray diffraction equipment, X-ray fluorescence, and X-ray imaging; semiconductor process control equipment, including semiconductor X-ray inspection and X-ray transmission equipment; and product-related warranty, repairs, maintenance, relocation, and other products. Its products are used in life science, academia, semiconductor electronic device, battery, and other applications. The company was founded in 1951 and is based in Akishima, Japan.

ipos.name: 東京地下鉄（株）
ipos.summary_en: Tokyo Metro Co., Ltd. engages in the operation and management of railways in Japan. It is involved in the urban design and lifestyle creation businesses. The company also manages shops at stations and other commercial facilities; develops and rents office buildings and hotels; and provides advertising media services, such as advertisements in stations, premises and trains, and an information and communications business that handles licensing of mobile phone communication services, as well as leases optical fiber cable, etc. The company was formerly known as Teito Rapid Transit Authority and changed its name to Tokyo Metro Co., Ltd. in 2004. The company was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

ipos.name: （株）Ｓｃｈｏｏ
ipos.summary_en: Schoo,inc. provides social change based online learning and education services in Japan. The company offers school for business, an online video training service that covers training and self-directed learning support to learning management; school for personal, a community-based video learning service for working adults that offers free live streaming classes; and School Swing, a data-driven learning management system that realizes digital transformation for higher education institutions and adult education providers. Schoo,inc. was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Shibuya, Japan.

ipos.name: （株）インターメスティック
ipos.summary_en: Intermestic Inc. sells eyeglasses and sunglasses in Japan. It also sells cases, cleaners, and other related accessories of eyeglasses and contact lens. It sells its products through stores and online. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in Minato, Japan.

ipos.name: （株）日水コン
ipos.summary_en: Nihon Suido Consultants Co., Ltd. provides construction consulting services for water supply and sewerage in Japan and internationally. Its consultancy services include arrangement, investigation, research, planning, design, construction supervision, facility operation, management, diagnosis, water quality inspection, economic and financial analysis, water supply, sewerage, industrial water supply, flood control, water utilization, and environmental management of rivers, lakes, marshes and coastal waters, treatment of industrial wastewater and waste, architecture, urban and regional development, agricultural development, renewable energy. The company is also involved in the development, sales, rental, operation, and maintenance of information processing systems, as well as temporary staffing; contracting, construction, and supervision of architectural, civil engineering, and various plant works; and procurement, sale, lease and rental of materials and equipment. Nihon Suido Consultants Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1959 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

ipos.name: 飛島ホールディングス（株）
ipos.summary_en: TOBISHIMA HOLDINGS Inc. engages in the construction business in Japan and internationally. The company is involved in the research, survey, planning, drafting, designing, supervision, and operation of civil engineering, construction work and contracting, as well as regional development, urban and marine development, and environmental improvement; mediation of corporate acquisitions, mergers, company splits, share exchanges and transfers, business transfers, capital alliances, and business alliances; computer-based information processing and hardware and software development; and mediation related to corporate management strategies, organizational and business restructuring, and corporate revitalization, as well as non-life insurance agency, insurance agency, and life insurance solicitation businesses. It also engages in housing, real estate transaction, and real estate leasing businesses; planning, drafting, designing, holding, maintenance, management, operation, and management of public facilities; supply of energy, such as electricity and heat; contract maintenance and management of buildings and facilities incidental to buildings; entrustment of security and security; acquisition, licensing, and sale of industrial property rights, copyrights, and know-how; planning, design, manufacture, and sale of plant factories; and research and development related to the production of agricultural, forestry, and fishery products. In addition, the company manufactures, procures, sells, and leases construction machinery and equipment, civil engineering, and construction-related materials; produces, processes, and sells agricultural, forestry, and fishery products; provides temporary staffing and paid employment placement; and engages in projects related to the remediation of environmental pollution. TOBISHIMA HOLDINGS Inc. was incorporated in 2024 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

ipos.name: ジーエルテクノホールディングス（株）
ipos.summary_en: Gltechno Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in analytical instruments, Semiconductors, automated recognition, and related businesses. It offers liquid and gas chromatography, antenna separated and integrated module, wall-mounted reader/writer, desktop USB reader, security cabinet, face recognition system, reagent management system, IC cards, label-type tags, and processing tags. The company was founded in 2024 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

ipos.name: AIフュージョンキャピタルグループ（株）
ipos.summary_en: Ai Fusion Capital Group Corp.is principal investment firm specializing in companies that provide AI solutions and conventional venture investment. It is also engage in management and administration of the group companies that are in to Investment in venture companies and formation and administration of Investment Funds, and as well as all associated and related these businesses. Ai Fusion Capital Group Corp. was founded in October 1, 2024 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

ipos.name: （株）ＥＴＳグループ
ipos.summary_en: ETS Group Co.,Ltd engages in the electric power business in Japan and internationally. The company surveys, designs, and constructs overhead and underground transmission lines, substations, civil engineering, pipe, etc. It involved in electrical equipment construction, instrumentation equipment construction, information and communication equipment construction, and disaster prevention and crime prevention equipment construction activities, as well as design, construction, and maintenance management of energy-saving equipment construction, etc. In addition, it provides services, such as preservation, inspection, repair, maintenance planning, and administrative management of buildings and facilities, as well as the placement of cleaning staff and administrators, and various maintenance services. Further, the company offers support services for domestic and international companies. The company was founded in 1922 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

ipos.name: シマダヤ（株）
ipos.summary_en: Shimadaya Corporation manufactures and sells noodles and related food products in Japan. The company offers udon, buckwheat, ramen, cold ramen/cold dipping noodles, yakisoba and other fried noodles, pasta, and broth and ingredients. It sells its products under flowing noodles; healthy noodles; true hit; honjo; ryusui-men, shinuchi; kenbimen; noukou kaiwai; clock tower; teppan noodles; local Chinese restaurant; and momiuchi brands. In addition, it exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
